title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. translated_title: 基于Q的变分逆强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16888v1 公告类型：新 摘要：安全且有益的AI发展要求系统能够学习和行动以符合人类偏好。然而，手工明确指定这些偏好通常是不可行的。逆强化学习（IRL）通过从专家行为中推断偏好（以奖励函数表示）来解决这一挑战。我们提出了基于Q的变分IRL（QVIRL），一种新颖的贝叶斯IRL方法，它主要通过学习最优Q值上的变分分布，从专家演示中恢复奖励的后验分布。与先前方法不同，QVIRL结合了可扩展性与不确定性量化，这对安全关键应用以及主动学习至关重要。我们展示了QVIRL在学徒学习中的强大性能，涵盖各种任务，包括网格世界、月球着陆器、高速公路环境以及两个ATARI游戏，既使用静态专家数据也使用主动学习。
tldr: QVIRL是一种新型贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过变分学习最优Q值分布来高效推断奖励后验，兼具可扩展性和不确定性量化，在多个任务中表现出色。
en_tdlr: QVIRL is a novel Bayesian inverse reinforcement learning method that efficiently infers reward posteriors by variationally learning optimal Q-value distributions, combining scalability with uncertainty quantification, and performing strongly across various tasks.
